verdict.rationale: Meltano can be fully self-hosted, so the operator keeps data on their own servers [meltano-docs-21, meltano-docs-39]. Stream and property selection lets users limit what data is extracted at all [meltano-docs-19]. Together these imply user control over data, but the pack documents no explicit retention or deletion features, and nothing covers retention policy for the Meltano-hosted managed offering. Missing for 10: documented retention policies or settings, deletion or purge mechanisms (including for state and logs), retention/deletion terms for the hosted offering, and independent corroboration.
